topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Well, traveler, it seems the winds didn’t favor your swift return. A delay, they say, can be as much a part of the journey as the steps we take along the path. Missing an important event, I know, can weigh heavy on the heart, much like a rain that comes too late for the wheat. But perhaps this extra time can be a chance to rest your feet, to mend a shoe, or to share a tale with a stranger who might become a friend. In our village, when the harvest is late, we find other ways to make the day fruitful. May your wait bring you some unexpected bounty.
